item.title: Creating Your Life — Wed Aug 19, 7:30 PM
item.description:
The Santa Rosa Spiritual Experiences Group Creating your life is easy. You can't help it. The life you are living now is a reflection of everything you have ever said, felt, thought, or done in any life...actually over all your lives.
In this in-depth and enlightening discussion, we'll explore how you've been creating your life, and give you tools so you can re-shape your future and create the life you'd love to live. We'll share stories, tips and techniques so you can learn...
* how you create or accept everything in your life, * how the mind works, * ways to use your imagination, * why you should be wary of experts or influencers, and * exercises you can work with to live your best life.
*The creative imagination gives us a way to make our dreams come true.* —Harold Klemp, *The Awakening Soul*, p. 17
All are welcome — family and friends — so come join the discussion.
Source: The Santa Rosa Spiritual Experiences Group

item.title: Introduction to Inks Workshop — Sat Aug 22, 11:00 AM — Rileystreet Art Supply
item.description:
Presenter: Staff member, Crash
Date: Saturday, August 22
Time: 11am - 1pm
Location: San Rafael store
Free Hands-On Workshop: Introduction to Inks
Discover the world of inks in this free, hands-on workshop! Whether you’re new to inks or looking to explore techniques, this workshop is an opportunity to experiment, compare and get inspired.
We’ll explore a variety of popular inks, including Higgins, FW, Liquitex, Ranger Ink, and more and demonstrate their different characteristics, applications and creative possibilities. You’ll have a chance to get hands-on and see how these inks work with different techniques and surfaces.
Come learn about the differences between inks, discover new ways to use them in your artwork, and experiment with color, layering, blending and more.
No experience necessary-just bring your curiosity and creativity!
Materials will be provided for this workshop.
Source: Riley Street Art Supply

item.description:

item.title: Book Group — Sun Aug 30, 2:00 PM — Off site
item.description:
CBA Book Group: MY RUSSIAN GRANDMOTHER AND HER AMERICAN VACUUM CLEANER Next up is MY RUSSIAN GRANDMOTHER AND HER AMERICAN VACUUM CLEANER by acclaimed Israeli writer Meir Shalev. (Memoir, 224 pgs, Hebrew 2009, English translation, 2010.) Short, funny, and about an Eastern European Jew who came to Palestine in the 1920s. We do welcome all CBA members and friends and meet in book club members' homes. We are a part of the SF Jewish Community Library's book club in a box. Usually, I check out 12 English copies and a Hebrew one. This time I have only 11, because someone in the last group that had this selection didn't return it. So, we are doubling up since this is a popular book and much demand. Also, one copy can probably be borrowed from a local library, and according to Judy Stern, it is available as an audiobook. We'll meet Sunday, August 30, for discussion. Come join us! To borrow a book and for mtg. details phone Linda (707) 544-4532 landline.
Source: Congregation
